variants.label: R · 赤色日冕
variants.prompt: Edit the reference VFX storyboard with extremely strict preservation of its four panels, exact ivory mechanical egg, six petals, metal mechanisms, seven-button pedestal, camera, composition and exposure. Change ONLY the gold and amber energy effects into a cinematic crimson / scarlet red version. Keep all ivory enamel and machined metal their original colors; this is NOT a red-painted shell. The contained core has an incandescent pale warm white center and scarlet-red plasma edges, with thin red-orange energy filaments, crimson seam lights, soft localized red reflected light on inner ribs and the base. Keep specular metal highlights neutral warm-white. Preserve realistic HDR glow with visible detail, avoid flat uniformly red colored outlines, avoid clipping, avoid bloody organic styling. Four panel labels now 'R1 IGNITION', 'R2 RED BLOOM', 'R3 CRIMSON CORONA', 'R4 SHUTDOWN'. Keep the discrete real red X button. This should be a directly comparable crimson alternative to the original gold storyboard, premium cinematic Atomic Heart-inspired industrial sci-fi.

variants.label: B · 磁场编织
variants.prompt: Using the exact ivory enamel HELIOS egg, the six mechanically hinged opening petals, internal gyro sun and seven-button pedestal from the supplied image, create a distinctly NEW cinematic VFX option labelled 'B MAGNETIC LOOM'. Preserve the model design and Atomic Heart-inspired retro-industrial identity. Wide 2-by-2 premium photoreal keyframe sheet on charcoal studio background, same object scale between panels. This option is based on magnetic containment, not solar fire. Palette: champagne white with subtle amber copper and a few silver-white contact arcs. 01 CLOSED CHARGE: thin short travelling luminous packets climb the dark seams; base segmented circuit flickers in a precise rotating sequence. 02 FIELD RELEASE: six petals expose the core while a dense but elegant handful of curved magnetic filaments wraps it as a twisted cage, stretching between actual inner gyro contacts and core; an intense contained white core and reflected gold light on inner mechanics; restrained spark jets from latch points. 03 MAGNETIC LOOM: three staggered luminous ellipses woven around the core at different angles with tiny fast orbiting particles and slender trailing filaments, quieter lit petal ribs, no giant hologram interface. 04 COLLAPSE: filaments pull into a single compressed bright bead, gyros align, petal seam lamps extinguish in a descending chase and two tiny valve pressure puffs finish the motion. Clearly make the woven magnetic cage the visual signature. Effects must be feasible as real-time ribbons, curves, particles and local lighting, not a new metal cage model. No blue holographic UI, no random smoke hiding the model, no fireworks, no added structures. Readable exact mechanism, tactile moderately worn nickel metal and creamy enamel.

variants.label: C · 高压苏醒
variants.prompt: Generate a NEW VFX storyboard variant for exactly the same HELIOS ivory six-petal mechanical egg and seven-button pedestal in the reference. Preserve the underlying model and its proportions absolutely, no new machinery design. Title 'C PRESSURE SYMPHONY'. Premium cinematic realistic Atomic Heart-like retro-industrial electromechanical awakening, emphasis on forceful MECHANICAL pressure and thermal contrast rather than floating rings. 2-by-2 wide charcoal studio keyframe plate. 01 PREHEAT closed: deep amber inspection filament warms, small precise red warning lamps blink, collar circuits charge, side valves exhale narrow wisps. 02 RELEASE opening: sharp compact opposing jets of warm lit white vapor from the actual side valve and base vents, a few short tungsten-white sparks at the six latch positions, a single shallow rippling amber pressure wave just above the pedestal. Core becomes a bright orange-white contained furnace, its light rakes across dark mechanical ribs and pistons; substantial, punchy but no giant explosion. 03 RUNNING open: pulsing incandescent core and limited heat shimmer near it, tiny animated steam curl at valve tips, thin warm lines inside petal structural ribs; metal feels oiled, heavy and alive. Enough contrast and speculars to read the real model. Effect focus stays near vents, bearings and core, with no opaque smoke occluding the sculpture. Original industrial sci-fi, cinematic VFX concept not a screenshot.

variants.label: D · 蚀光核心
variants.prompt: Use the supplied HELIOS storyboard as a strict MODEL reference, create a distinctly different cinematic VFX design called 'D ECLIPSE ENGINE'. Same creamy ivory six-petal mechanical egg, real dark nickel gyro rings and seven-button display pedestal, with red X shutdown button. Do not redesign or replace any hardware. Make a wide 2x2 cinematic keyframe sheet in a dark charcoal studio, same framing and model scale in each panel. The key visual signature is an impossibly dark central miniature orb surrounded by a sharply luminous white-gold edge and a thin flowing amber accretion ribbon: strange, elegant and technologically uncanny, still original Atomic Heart-inspired machinery. 01 IGNITION closed: base segmented lamps chase inward, several soft luminous filaments appear in the inspection window. 02 ECLIPSE BLOOM: petals part revealing the dark energy orb within the ACTUAL metal gyro rings; its rim flares sharply white-gold while a thin asymmetric amber accretion disk wraps the orb, subtle short distortion of nearby light and a few spiralling motes, mechanical interior is lit by warm reflected edge light, no opaque fireball. 03 STABLE ECLIPSE: a dark core with controlled golden corona plus two narrow tapered accretion ribbons, crisp bright contact points on rotating gyros, outer petal ribs barely illuminated and readable; surreal scientific exhibit, luxurious and powerful. 04 SHUTDOWN: disk shrinks into a thin luminous line, rings align, core light collapses to a tiny point and petals close with a last ring of warm light on base. Effects should be feasible in real time with shaded core material, ribbons, particles, local lights; no full screen postprocessing distortion, no floating UI, no extra structures, no space background, no giant magic circle. Preserve rich aged metal and enamel specular material quality.
